items.title: The bond market is one of the key spots to watch at the moment
items.summary: If you only got eyes on one asset class this week, there is a good argument that the bond market is one to pay the most attention to. The Fed's recent twist and turn, alongside softer US economic data, may have dampened rate hike hopes for a bit.
items.summaryZh: 如果您本周只关注一种资产类别，那么有一个很好的论据表明，债券市场是最值得关注的市场。美联储最近的波动，加上美国经济数据疲软，可能在一定程度上抑制了加息的希望。
items.summaryEn: If you only got eyes on one asset class this week, there is a good argument that the bond market is one to pay the most attention to. The Fed's recent twist and turn, alongside softer US economic data, may have dampened rate hike hopes for a bit.
